project_type: Unity 6.4 URP singleplayer game prototype - CS 1.6 JailBreak mod
build_system: Unity Editor scripts with menu buttons - user drags Scripts folder into Assets
test_framework: No automated tests - validation is syntax/compilation correctness
build_command: N/A - Unity Editor compiles scripts on import
test_command: N/A - verify syntax correctness by reading code
verification_instructions: Verify all C# files have correct syntax, proper using statements, no missing references between scripts, and follow Unity 6 API conventions
setup_instructions: User deletes old Scripts folder, copies new Scripts folder into Unity Assets, then uses JailBreak menu button
environment_constraints: No Unity Editor available in sandbox - validation is code review and syntax checking only. Cannot compile or run.
contribution_requirements: All scripts use New Input System (UnityEngine.InputSystem), URP materials (Shader.Find Universal Render Pipeline/Lit), primitives-based visuals, single Editor script with one Build Full Game menu button

key_patterns.materials: new Material(Shader.Find("Universal Render Pipeline/Lit")) with mat.color = ...

key_patterns.ui_pattern: OnGUI() with GUIStyle for all HUD elements (no Canvas/UGUI)
key_patterns.naming: PascalCase for classes, camelCase for fields, descriptive names

relevant_files: Scripts/Editor/JailBreakEditor.cs - THE main editor script, builds entire scene
